logic.summary: Experience first, astrology explains after. Preserve factual astrology headlines and generate readable, actionable voice from source-backed fields.

entries.base_rule: Write the observable experience first; astrology explains after.
entries.example_good_baseline: A conversation may need clarification before it can be trusted.
entries.avoid: Mercury and Neptune create confusing energy.

entries.base_rule: Describe tendencies and choice points, not fixed identity.
entries.example_good_baseline: You may notice a tendency to gather information before committing to a decision.

entries.base_rule: Describe temporary activation of a natal pattern, not destiny.
entries.example_good_baseline: A current conversation may bring an old decision pattern back into focus.
entries.avoid: This transit will change your life.
